brief:
Al Jazeera English examined how Israeli political parties voted on eight Knesset bills disadvantageous to Palestinians in the lead-up to the election. AJLabs analyzed voting patterns across the legislature to document party positions on measures affecting Palestinian rights and interests.

The analysis provides a record of legislative stances that may inform Palestinian assessments of potential policy shifts depending on election outcomes. The tracking focuses on concrete voting records rather than campaign rhetoric from Israeli parties.
dek: AJLabs tracks how Israeli parties voted against eight Knesset bills that disfavoured Palestinians ahead of the election.
title: Study tracks Israeli parties' votes on Palestinian-related bills before elections
